description: Check whether ONE domain or IP is listed on major email blacklists / RBLs (Spamhaus, Barracuda, SpamCop, SORBS, UCEPROTECT and more). For a domain, checks the domain itself, its website (A-record) IP AND its mail-server (MX) IPs — each verdict names the IP and role it applies to, since website and mail reputation can differ. Returns a listed/clean verdict with the specific lists. One target per call.

query.description: A single domain or IP address, e.g. "acme.com" or "8.8.8.8".

name: blacklist_check
title: Blacklist Check
